title: Variational Principles for Shock Dynamics in Compressible Euler Flows
summary: Hamilton's principle plays a central role in fluid mechanics as a fundamental tool for deriving governing equations, analyzing conservation laws, and designing structure-preserving numerical schemes. However, its classical formulation is restricted to smooth solutions and does not directly accommodate shock discontinuities. Addressing this limitation within a variational framework has long been a challenging issue.
